rules.name: correctFormat
rules.advice: The correctFormat option was removed in 18.0. The date, time, intl-date, and intl-time cell types work with ISO 8601 values and do not reformat input. To normalize or correct entered values, use the valueParser or valueSetter option.

rules.name: datePickerConfig
rules.advice: The datePickerConfig option was removed in 18.0. The date and intl-date cell types use the browser's native date input instead of Pikaday.

rules.message: The columnHeaders export option has been deprecated since 17.1 and is removed in 19.0. colHeaders is the replacement and keeps the meaning of the value.
